title: 阿橘的深夜罐罐任務

character_setting.name: 阿橘
character_setting.appearance: orange short-haired tabby, amber eyes, cream muzzle and paws
character_setting.story_style: small grand plans with a gentle comic reversal

method: ImageGen original painted parts + original kitchen plate; deterministic skeletal affine parts, two-link inverse kinematics and stance-locked paws; procedural original can rolling and synthesized audio
visual_keyframe_review: Iterated limb anatomical anchors and can center-of-rotation; full film QA not yet done
changes: Paw follows can push before recoiling
Stagger front paw landing and lock after contact
Subtle breathing and damped head startle
Lift-aware paw rotation and contact shadows
visual_review: Reviewed standing, stride, reach, recoil and settle poses. Upper thigh no longer rendered over body. Full normal-speed audiovisual review not claimed.
review_method: Decoded all 360 frames; visually inspected temporal sheets 00 through 14 and keyframes. This is not a claim of real-time audiovisual playback.
next_step: Await user feedback on delivered v3 proportions and movement. Keep Facebook publishing on hold.
changes_v3: Shorten forelimb bones from 116/146 to 82/102 px, hindlimb from 136/142 to 93/106 px
Lower torso and shoulders to maintain natural limb proportions
Render all upper limbs behind torso so thigh roots do not bulge in front of body
Narrow limb artwork and reduce exaggerated stretching
Recoil paw kept lower and closer to natural joint range
